paragraphs: Today’s 9to5Toys Lunch Break is headlined by the last to lock-in Amazon deals on Pixel 11 deals – enhanced trade values, $350 gift cards, FREE Pixel Watch 5, and more. Amazon has also expanded its summer sale with latest Echo smart displays and speakers at up to 36% off with deals from $18 as well as Anker’s 26,250mAh Smart Display Power Bank up to $110 off and this more affordable model down at $70, as well as the TCL gallery-style mini-LED Google Smart TVs up to $600 off. Head below for a closer look.

Amazon was, by and large, the best place to score pre-order deals on the brand new Pixel 11, 11 Pro, 11 Pro XL, and 11 Pro Fold. Today is your last chance at the enhanced trade-in value, up to $350 in FREE gift cards, and the Pixel Watch 5 offers (you can even score the watch for FREE with select configs).

The countdown clocks are now counting down at Amazon and elsewhere on the Pixel 11 deals. The phones have already released and been delivered to pre-order customers, but the deals were extended right through and today is your last shot at them. We might very well catch some deals in the fall on these devices, but there’s no telling if we are going to see trade values and FREE gift cards offers like this:
***Note: All of the Amazon deals below stack with its enhanced trade-in credits (additional $250 back).
Update: Using code PIXEL11 at checkout on Amazon might drop the price down another $150 on Pixel 11 Pro XL – it does not appear to still be working for everyone, but it is very much worth a go.

This year’s Pixel 11 Dbrand Pixelsnap case lineup is now ready to go with its tried, tested, and true ultra-grippy model and the plethora of skin customizations alongside its zero-yellowing clear case, and the Tank – a highly-architectural and ultra-rugged protective solution that is available to Pixel users for the first time. You can also score $5 off its Prism Screen Protectors with the purchase of any case.

Just after spotting some all-time low pricing on the latest 4K Ring Doorbells, Amazon is expanding its late summer deals today starting from $17 with a host of price drops on Fire TV gear and across its latest Echo smart speaker and display lineups.

Amazon is now offering up to 36% off a range of its current-generation Echo devices. While not quite as low as the Prime Day prices, the deals do include its latest slate of Echo Show 8 and 11 smart displays as well as its pro-grade Echo Studio and Echo Dot Max speakers.
